product.headline: Ukraine: Preparatory Activity Watch
product.confidence_rationale: Analytical confidence is low. The information base is incomplete: independent physical reporting is not yet available; official-posture collection is missing; public-reporting series share a substrate.
assessment: We assess it is almost certain that abnormal activity is present across several Russian observables with bearing on Ukraine.

Russian financial conditions (CBR, Moscow), Russian RIPEstat prefixes and public reporting on Russia and Ukraine are simultaneously elevated relative to their recent baselines. The signal is co-movement across those channels.
It is a realistic possibility that this reflects reversible preparation, defensive readiness, routine variation or exercise activity. Present reporting does not discriminate among those explanations.
The decision this supports is collection against independent physical posture on those AOIs.

watchlist.observation: CBR funding spread reached 3.72σ on 11 Feb after 2.54σ on 10 Feb
watchlist.implication: Strongest abnormality in the window; unusually large move in domestic funding conditions.

watchlist.observation: RIPE prefixes remained 2.78–3.14σ above baseline for three days
watchlist.implication: Persistent rather than transient infrastructure anomaly.

watchlist.observation: GDELT reporting remained elevated; Wikipedia attention rose from 66,480 to 120,857 views
watchlist.implication: Confirms a heightened information environment; partly dependent on the same public reporting.

watchlist.observation: FIRMS recorded one thermal detection within the monitored staging AOIs on 12 Feb.

watchlist.implication: Does not reinforce the broader anomaly.

supports: We assess it is almost certain that abnormal activity is present across several Russian observables with bearing on Ukraine.
caveats: GDELT, ICEWS and Wikipedia share a public-reporting substrate.

hypotheses.discriminate: Anomalies decay without additional domains activating.
Physical activity consistent with announced exercise patterns.
Persistent posture indicators without further domain broadening.
Additional independent logistical, financial or spatial indicators.
Sustained multi-domain increase plus corroborating physical or official-posture evidence.
Anomalies disappear after source or baseline validation.

collection.title: Physical posture — highest priority
collection.why: The anomaly is strongest in financial, infrastructure and information indicators. Independent physical evidence on Yelnya, Klintsy, Belgorod, Valuyki, Boguchar, Millerovo and Dzhankoi would discriminate. VIIRS NTL not yet available at this cutoff. SAR/backscatter coverage for the last episode day is also unavailable.

collection.title: Official posture
collection.why: Collect contemporaneous Russian, Ukrainian, UK, US and relevant allied official statements and formal measures, including travel advice, diplomatic drawdowns, defence announcements, NOTAM/NAVAREA restrictions and sanctions measures. Identify changes in declared threat assessment or costly government action.

collection.title: Financial persistence
collection.why: Determine whether the abnormal CBR funding conditions persist or intensify. USD/RUB data for the last episode day are not yet available.

collection.title: Information-environment composition
collection.why: Current data establish increased volume and attention, not tone, narrative concentration or source diversity.
